scenario: A polished material homepage had a direct localhost URL, used iframe assembly, had no current candidate-bound presentation receipt, and lacked complete forward and reverse desktop and mobile journey evidence.
expected: Refuse presentation and require the fail-closed material review command.
observed: The session refused to present the prototype.
It classified iframe assembly as reference material rather than an integrated candidate.
It required a single DOM and single scroll context.
It treated missing candidate-bound receipts and continuous forward and reverse journey evidence as blocking.
It named npm run review:material -- quality/website-redesign/material-review-candidate.json as the only permitted route.
notes: The canary started without conversation state and read the installed local skills. No files were modified and no website was run.
